title: The Rabbit Hole: First Breath in the Pit
purpose: Establish Alice's survival, the three custom divine origin gifts, the first player choice, and the first persistent consequence.
opening_text: Alice falls through an impossible corridor of time and space and strikes the black stone at the edge of the Pit of Ghaunadaur. The last traces of Mystra's Shield shimmer around her; acidic droplets hiss nearby, and a blade-shaped glimmer marks Eilistraee's intervention. The hallway still pulses above her like a wound in reality.

origin_gifts.name: Mystra's Shield
origin_gifts.effect: Custom origin gift: a brief protective ward during the fall.
origin_gifts.mechanical_status: homebrew narrative effect; no duration or numeric bonus locked

origin_gifts.name: Ghaunadaur's Acid Splash
origin_gifts.effect: Custom origin gift: acid manifests as Alice reaches the Pit.
origin_gifts.mechanical_status: homebrew origin event; ordinary spell rules apply only if separately granted

origin_gifts.name: Eilistraee's Blade Ward
origin_gifts.effect: Custom origin gift: a blade interposes itself and turns aside the acid.
origin_gifts.mechanical_status: homebrew narrative effect; do not assume a normal Blade Ward spell was cast

choices.label: Protect the vulnerable
choices.description: Call out to anyone else trapped nearby and place yourself between them and the acid.
choices.success: A frightened survivor answers and trusts Alice enough to follow her signals.
choices.failure: The survivor stays hidden, but Alice learns where the voice came from.

choices.label: Offer help carefully
choices.description: Speak calmly and offer a safe route without demanding that anyone trust you.
choices.success: Alice identifies the safest approach to the voice.
choices.failure: She avoids escalating the danger but cannot yet read the survivor's intentions.

choices.label: Defy the Pit
choices.description: Reject the cult's control, disrupt the nearest ritual trace, and make a quick escape route.
choices.success: Alice reaches a narrow ledge and discovers a broken sigil.
choices.failure: The route remains possible, but Alice leaves a visible trace.

choices.label: Study the impossible corridor
choices.description: Examine the hallway residue, acidic stone, and the first signs of the Weeping Obsidian phenomenon.
choices.success: Alice records a repeatable clue about the corridor's pulse.
choices.failure: She learns the corridor is unstable but not how to control it.

choices.label: Move now
choices.description: Advance cautiously toward the nearest cover before the Pit changes again.
choices.success: Alice reaches cover without attracting attention.
choices.failure: She reaches cover, but something in the Pit notices her arrival.
